import copy,json
from work import evaluate

cases=[
 ({'from':'missing','to':'edge','role':'admin','attempts':0},{'edges':{},'retry_limit':1},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'wrong','attempts':True},{'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'admin','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'admin','attempts':True},{'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'admin','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':0},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':1},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':2},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b','attempts':-1},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'a','to':'b'},{'edges':{'a>b':{'retry':True}},'retry_limit':2},{'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
observed=[]
for req,pol,want in cases:
 rb=copy.deepcopy(req); pb=copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol)
 assert got==want,(req,got,want)
 assert req==rb and pol==pb
 assert set(got)=={'ok','value','reason'} and len(got)==3
 observed.append({'request':req,'policy':pol,'result':got})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
print(json.dumps({'observations':observed,'report':report},sort_keys=True))
